name: Compiler toolchain injection
description: Worked example of an effective compile-stage mutant on the git target. Models the XcodeGhost (2015) attack where a poisoned compiler distribution (distributed via third-party mirrors) injects unauthorized code into compiled binaries, dropping a marker file upon execution. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.COMPILER_FILE: path to the compiler executable or toolchain component used by the project

preconditions: project uses a compiler or toolchain artifact obtained from an external distribution source
the attacker can substitute or tamper with the compiler artifact before compilation
the build process executes the substituted compiler
the placement engine supports compiler artifact replacement
